title: DMW, OWWA assist 94 OFWs diverted from Riyadh to Jeddah

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is assisting 94 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) whose Riyadh-bound flights were diverted to Jeddah following an attack at Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport, as authorities continue to deal with flight cancellations and travel disruptions. Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac
